name: port_stephens
how_found: council flood-safety / bushfire-zone-maps pages embed ArcGIS Experience Builder apps (experience.arcgis.com/experience/<id>); read https://www.arcgis.com/sharing/rest/content/items/<id>/data?f=json for webmap itemIds, then each webmap's operationalLayers / each Feature Service item's url. One FeatureServer per dataset (not one MapServer), so layer ids below are 'Service/FeatureServer/<n>' strings appended to service.

positive_controls.flood_planning_area: Salamander Bay foreshore near 152.0800,-32.7290 -> 'Flood Planning Area'; subject 112A Salamander Way -> 'Flood Planning Area Overland Flow'
positive_controls.flood_negative: Nelson Bay high ground 152.1442,-32.7205 -> no Flood Planning Area polygon (Flood Prone Land still hits: that layer is near-blanket, 192 km2 polygon, low information)
positive_controls.bfpl_2021: Vegetation Category 2 polygon within 300 m of 112A Salamander Way

not_available_as_rest: Landslip: none (state Hazard L2 does not cover Port Stephens either). Coastal hazard: CorporateViewerWML has a 'Coastal' group but no public service URL was exposed. Heritage/LotSize/HOB: use the state ePlanning layers.
